_doc: AI-vs-AI outcome sweeps (ref4 t04): parity_harness.py outcome --scenario ID runs alamo_headless with args plus --seed s for s = 1..seeds and judges the share of seeds (outcome_sweep.py has the keys). Thresholds sit below the measured share so that one seed's battle moving is not a failure (docs/DECISIONS.md 'Parity tiers', 'Outcome tests over seeds'); a share falling under them is. Measured on dev 262a47b1 (2026-11-19, MSVC, workers 0). Change a threshold only with the new measurement and its reason in why, like a golden. The first five are ctests (engine/apps/CMakeLists.txt, alamo_headless_outcome_<id>, label slow).

foc_space.why: FoC space skirmish (_MP_SPACE_KUAT), Empire vs Rebel AI, must reach a decisive outcome (S7 t09). Measured 16/16 end, 6544-11129 frames (Empire, all destroyed); 14 of 16 must.

foc_station.why: An AI defender with a Level 2 station against a far larger fleet (t41 / t48): the battle ends, the defender does not retreat while its station stands (alamo_headless's own check), no Lua error outside retail's (the host refuses them in foc-station). Measured 9/12 end (seeds 5, 7, 12 slow sieges), 7705-12770 frames (Rebel, all destroyed); 6 of 12 must.

foc_land_campaign.why: The campaign-rules land invasion (Utapau) ends with a winner and proposes the Script_ land goals (alamo_headless's own check). Measured 9/12 end (8, 9, 11 reach the cap), 9138-13377 frames (Empire); 6 of 12 must. Ends as early as 2241 were seen (a1j, Rebel retreats), so the floor is 1500.

foc_land_full.why: FoC land skirmish (_MP_LAND_UTAPAU), Empire vs Rebel AI, the whole 36000 ticks with no Lua error outside retail's; no end needed (b0422, Gabriel 2026-11-15: AI against AI has no retail counterpart). Measured 0/6 end, one retail-documented Lua error (seed 5).
